name: flock
description: Applies or removes an advisory lock on an open file specified by a file descriptor. The operation can be a shared lock, exclusive lock, or unlock, and may block if incompatible locks are held by other processes.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the open file on which to apply or remove the lock

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: Operation to perform, such as LOCK_SH for shared lock, LOCK_EX for exclusive lock, LOCK_UN to remove a lock, and optionally LOCK_NB for non-blocking behavior

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: fd is not an open file descriptor
The call was interrupted by a signal while waiting for a lock
The kernel ran out of memory for allocating lock records
The file is locked and the LOCK_NB flag was specified

bugs: Converting a lock (e.g., shared to exclusive) is not guaranteed to be atomic, potentially allowing other lock requests in between; behavior varies with NFS and CIFS, where locks may interact with fcntl(2) or become mandatory.
